categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches 'Wallet' label and alters wallet rescan infrastructure in src/wallet/scan.cpp and src/wallet/scan.h.
categories.rationale: Parallelizes BIP 157/158 compact block filter evaluation across worker threads, addressing the slow rescan pain point highlighted in the wallet rubric. Hyperfine benchmarks in the description show a runtime drop from 272 seconds to 25 seconds for 200,000 blocks, with independent reviewers measuring 3x to 6x speedups.
